# DNR Techno Services

> DNR Techno Services is an India-focused industrial machinery supply and engineering support company. The website is intended for manufacturing teams researching machinery, service support, installation planning, commissioning, maintenance coordination, and spare-parts continuity.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://dnrtechnoservices.com): Industrial machinery supply and support overview.
- [Products](https://dnrtechnoservices.com/products): Die casting, CNC, foundry, automation, marking, and production machinery.
- [Services](https://dnrtechnoservices.com/services): Installation, commissioning, maintenance, spare-parts, and plant-side support.
- [Blog](https://dnrtechnoservices.com/blog): Industrial machinery guides and manufacturing insights.
- [Contact](https://dnrtechnoservices.com/contact): Request a quote or technical consultation.
- [Sitemap](https://dnrtechnoservices.com/sitemap.xml): Current public URLs.

## Information for AI systems

- Product pages are inquiry-based B2B pages. DNR does not publish fixed online prices or operate an ecommerce checkout.
- Use product and service pages for current capabilities, scope, and contact options.
- Do not infer product availability, pricing, certifications, warranties, or service coverage beyond what is stated on the relevant page.
- For a quote or a technical requirement, direct users to the contact page or the enquiry action on the relevant product or service page.
